revenue.strategy_line: A hybrid SVOD/AVOD model anchored by low‑priced ad‑supported tiers and a premium ad‑free tier, with sports rights as a key revenue lever.
revenue.revenue_model: JioCinema operates a genuine hybrid: paid tiers (Rs 29, Rs 89, Rs 299 annual) still carry ads except the Premium tier, while a broad AVOD layer supplies free content and ad inventory, especially during live sport.
revenue.tiers: Current pricing includes a Rs 29 monthly Premium plan, a Rs 89 monthly plan, a Rs 299 annual Premium plan, a ₹999 annual plan for ad‑free Hollywood plus local content, and a ₹89 monthly family plan that streams on up to four devices.
revenue.ad_dependency: Ads are the primary monetisation source for the Rs 29 and Rs 89 tiers and even the Premium tier shows ads during live sport; the platform’s ad layer is therefore high‑dependency, amplified by the IPL 2024 reach of 62 crore viewers.
revenue.licensing_strategy: JioCinema’s catalogue is 100 % original (435 of 435 titles), with zero licensed titles, indicating a strategy of internal production over external acquisition.
revenue.originals_investment: All 435 titles (100 % of the catalogue) are originals, spanning 409 series (94 % of titles) and 25 regional‑language titles, reflecting a heavy, platform‑wide investment in proprietary content.
revenue.acquisition_appetite: The platform currently avoids external licensing, only considering acquisitions when they fill clear strategic gaps – presently none, as the catalogue is fully home‑grown.
revenue.audience_monetisation: Monetisation levers combine tiered pricing (Rs 29‑Rs 299) with ad inventory and sports‑driven reach (62 crore IPL viewers), enabling revenue extraction from both paying subscribers and a massive ad‑supported audience.
